items.title: iVirus 2.0: Cyberinfrastructure-supported tools and data to power DNA virus ecology
items.context: An update to the original iVirus work. iVirus expands to KBase, adding new tools, datasets, and workflows alongside continued CyVerse support.

items.title: iVirus: facilitating new insights in viral ecology with software and community data sets imbedded in a cyberinfrastructure
items.context: The original iVirus paper, introducing the project and its community data and software resources within CyVerse.

items.title: Marine DNA Viral Macro- and Microdiversity from Pole to Pole
items.context: Global-scale characterization of marine DNA viral diversity from pole to pole, leveraging iVirus tools for single-amplified virus analysis.

items.title: Long-read viral metagenomics captures abundant and microdiverse viral populations and their niche-defining genomic islands
items.context: Demonstrates iVirus tools applied to long-read viromics, revealing abundant and microdiverse viral populations and their genomic islands.

items.title: Single-virus genomics reveals hidden cosmopolitan and abundant viruses
authors: de la Cruz Peña, M. J.
items.context: Single-virus genomics approach uncovering hidden, cosmopolitan viral populations using iVirus tools.

items.title: Soil Viruses Are Underexplored Players in Ecosystem Carbon Processing
items.context: Applied iVirus tools to explore viruses in soil ecosystems and their underappreciated roles in carbon cycling.

items.title: Viral Ecogenomics of Arctic Cryopeg Brine and Sea Ice
items.context: Viral ecogenomics of extreme Arctic environments using iVirus-based analytical workflows.

items.title: Taxonomic assignment of uncultivated prokaryotic virus genomes is enabled by gene-sharing networks
items.context: Introduces the vConTACT2 framework — the updated gene-sharing network approach for assigning virus taxonomy.

items.title: Putative archaeal viruses from the mesopelagic ocean
items.context: Discovery of putative archaeal viruses from the mesopelagic ocean, identified using iVirus tools integrated into CyVerse.

items.title: vConTACT: an iVirus tool to classify double-stranded DNA viruses that infect Archaea and Bacteria
items.context: Introduces the original vConTACT tool — a foundational iVirus pipeline for classifying dsDNA viruses via gene-sharing networks.
